source_note: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散
english_source_note: Competing Decreasing Sequences and Series Divergence
callout_id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#4
statement_en: Let $\alpha_n,\beta_n$ be two nonnegative nonincreasing real sequences, and suppose both series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n$ and $\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n$ diverge. Must the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$ also diverge?
callout_body: $\alpha_n,\beta_n$是两个非负不增的实数列，并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\alpha_n,\sum_{n\geq 1}\beta_n$发散。那么级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\min\{\alpha_n,\beta_n\}$是否一定发散？
